reviews.text: Ronald and his team were professional and banged out two separate renovations at once with speed and accuracy. Ronald even helped with designing a custom wash basin from scratch- all on the fly. The results are fantastic and I will definitely use them in the future. Highly recommend!

We hired Ronald and his team to paint two rooms in our home, add custom carpentry and repair drywall. He was incredibly professional, on time, clean and did wonderful work. We're very happy with the custom carpentry and would work with him again.

I had some issues with a paint job from another contractor.  I needed a new one and called CJ's.  Ronald and crew and came over and finished my job beautifully.   On time, clean, very courteous.   Thanks again for helping me out.  You can't go wrong with this company.  Great prices and service.
